description: Patterns that must appear in the user-facing documentation set, and patterns that must NOT appear anywhere in it. The set is README.md plus every page under docs/. must_contain rules are scoped: 'readme' pins a pattern to README.md itself (the quick-start surface a user lands on first); 'doc_set' only requires it to be reachable somewhere in the set, so per-harness detail can live in docs/ without the assertion rotting. must_not_contain is enforced per-file across the WHOLE set — a prohibited pattern must not be reintroducible by moving prose out of README.
